news.headline: Rising yields rattled the market, but we’re sticking with our favorite AI and retail stocks
news.summary: Bond yields climbed, spooking equities across the board. But our conviction in high-growth AI and resilient retail plays remains unchanged—the fundamentals still point to outperformance.

news.headline: Microsoft Fixes 'Perfect 10' Exploit That Could Have Let Hackers Run Code Remotely
news.summary: Microsoft closed a critical Entra ID vulnerability that could have enabled remote code execution, scoring the highest severity rating possible. The company patched the flaw before disclosure and detected no signs of active exploitation in the wild.

educational.title: What a Recession Actually Means (And What It Doesn't)
points: A recession is broadly defined as a significant decline in economic activity
It's not the same as a stock market crash — they can happen independently
Recessions typically bring rising unemployment and falling consumer spending
They're a normal part of economic cycles, not a rare catastrophe
Historically, markets have recovered from every recession, though timing varies
